thread:
kevin: Noticing a cluster of fncall validator rejections landing in fallback in eu-central. Cost chart shows token rate unchanged but requests_count->degen up ~30% :confused:

sana: Can you paste an example log? Need to know if parser rejected or schema mismatch.

kevin: snippet from api logs: 
```
ERROR fn_validate: req=xyz987 reason=extra_props path=tool.args metadata.route=primary -> fallback
```

lee: If extra_props is the reason, that often means model emitted additional keys our adapter doesn't accept. Current behavior: route to fallback_model and still count tokens normally. That inflates model costs without obvious cause.

kevin: Right. Customer dashboards just show higher spend on model X. No visible tag saying "validation routed".

ops-bot: alert: validation-service: reason=extra_props count=120 route=fallback sample=0.05

ui-team: We should add a tiny probe card on model pages: "Validation routed requests" with a small sparkline and top reasons. Clicking a reason opens redacted samples.

sana: Telemetry proposal: emit metric fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed",reason="extra_props",route="fallback",slice="canary-2"} and trace tag validation.reason. Keep reason enum small (missing, extra_props, type_error, parse_error).

lee: Agree but watch label cardinality. Slice values are limited to canaries we define. Also add bool label billing_tagged="true|false" so billing pipeline can pick up.

kevin: For billing I propose we tag routed requests with validation_status=routed in event stream. Billing team can map to a hold-bucket for review. Dont auto-deduct yet.

ui-team: On samples: backend should provide a /samples?reason=extra_props&route=fallback that returns 50 redacted examples. Redaction rules: hide keys that look like email/token/secret and truncate long text.

ops-bot: deploy-note: canary patch pushed to staging by sana (feature/validate-labels).

sana: Implementation checklist Ill do:
- add metric fncall_validation_total with labels (route,reason,outcome,slice)
- add event field validation_status to kafka event for billing pipeline
- add trace tag validation.reason and fallback_model when routing occurs
- samples API endpoint with redact defaults

lee: Alerting rule suggestion: sum(rate(fncall_validation_total{outcome="routed",route!=""}[5m])) by (route) > 0.01 * sum(rate(fncall_requests_total[5m])) by (route) -> page. That catches >1% routed.

kevin: UX: make tooltip explain "routed to fallback because validation failed" and link to RFC. Product wants wording that avoids alarming customers (explain canary vs production).

ui-team: Weil show a small status pill next to model variant: green=healthy, amber=validation-routes>0.5%, red=>2% for 15m.

sana: Note: sampling strategy: default sample_rate=0.05 for extra_props/missing; sample_rate=1.0 for parse_error or when route traffic spike>threshold. Will expose knob via infra-config.

kevin: Can someone draft a short RFC with metric names, sample endpoints, and billing tagging? I can validate in the eu-central canary window tomorrow 14:00 CET.

lee: IIl draft. Will include Prom examples and migration notes (how to backfill, cardinality limits).

ops-bot: autoscaler: noted increased fallback traffic; recommend scaling variant pool +1 for 10m during probe.

kevin: Thanks. Post RFC here when ready. Also add a small playbook blurb for oncall: check samples API and decide whether to disable strict route for the slice.

ui-team: RFC stub: https://console.redwood.ai/rfcs/validation-routing-probe (WIP)

kevin: Great. Ending thread, will follow RFC. Thanks everyone :pray:
